changelog: Forge batch: building is free for now (budget off); ghost preview + move/rotate/repair/delete placed structures; destructible structures; Forge syncs in multiplayer; real per-weapon Forge costs; new Build presets (stairs, ramps, walls, jump pads, cover pieces, sniper nests); shareable build codes + history search; Create-a-Mod is now its own main-menu widget (structured form, procedural voxel assets, sandbox test before install); voice forging v2 with confirm before building.
